rules.statement: A judgment cannot be relied on as res judicata for a different cause of action in a subsequent suit.
rules.supporting_quote: If we look at section 34 it is clear that a plaintiff must include the which of the claim he is entitled to make in respect of his cause of action, but he may relinquish a part of it to enable him to bring his action in a cheaper scale. If he omits to sue in respect of, or intentionally relinquishes any portion of, his claim, he cannot afterwards sue in respect of the portion so omitted. If he has more than one remedy for the same cause of action, and omits without the leave of the Court obtained before the hearing to sue for any of such remedies, he cannot afterwards sue for the remedy so omitted.
